title: get_form_context_by_form_token selects rc.form_token that nothing reads, with a comment claiming the resend flow needs it
evidence:
sql:9 `-- form_token itself is selected: the resend flow needs the CURRENT token to`
sql:10 `-- build the fresh form URL after a remint.`
sql:15 `       rc.form_token,`
form_handler.gleam:603 `      form_token: new_token,`
(grep of server/src + server/test shows no read of GetFormContextByFormTokenRow.form_token)
detail: The resend flow builds the fresh URL from the newly minted token (form_token: new_token), never from the row. The selected column is dead weight and the comment misleads: a future edit following it would use the pre-remint old token.
recommended_fix: Drop rc.form_token from the SELECT (and the Option(String) row field), or correct the comment to say the resend uses the minted new_token, not the row's current token.
